methods.comparison: Current 3-sentence context and fixed older points. Exact isolated paragraph scoring on the selected plain email body as a research-only projection; app .eml scope remains disabled for the opt-in option.
methods.metric: Use exact normalized source hashes and known edit intervals, non-whitespace IoU >=0.30, human-file/source-group flags and paired retained, lost or additional useful selections.
methods.mime: Synthetic quoted-printable multipart EML on local disk. App must select its exact text/plain body, preserve archive body Unicode codepoints, mark all selected source as body and exclude alternate HTML and dummy attachment.
methods.native_points: Same .5 raw check boundary and one-paragraph selection using first two interior paragraphs that pass current; no refit or change to any overall score.
methods.scope: Four authentic same-sender long bodies, two exact human-splice controls each, and one target-only rewrite attempt per source and family. Seven selected shorter original bodies have no fabricated positive, no paragraph review eligibility and a separate raw readout.

publication_readout.note: Short-case paragraph transitions are labeled unassessed instead of zero and have no flag counts. Physical interior paragraph counts are labeled separately from qualifying inputs. Score, eligibility and terminal commitments are unchanged.

scope: Authentic archival workplace bodies in synthetic EML; fixed body-only paragraph projection is research-only. No email serving or confidence change.

policy.author: A documented NARA or State Department staff message in the official government work archive. Retain substantive body segments that clearly belong to the identified federal-duty sender. Repeated or forwarded full threads, personal correspondence, contact details, missing redactions, attachments and signatures stay outside inputs.
policy.independence: A selected sender appears once. Paragraph fingerprints check against known earlier project text and across this panel, including paired edits. Archives contain routine records work within two linked agencies, and pretraining exposure is unknown.
policy.long: Four preselected authentic email-body excerpts with exactly four surviving published paragraphs. A few salutation/signature/short or incomplete blocks were omitted. Whitespace and archive soft hyphens are normalized. No correction of the underlying OCR wording. Whole and single-sentence edits use only verified source text from the same employee.
policy.rights: U.S. government works under 17 U.S.C. §§ 101 and 105. Reuse is limited to verified employee prose created as part of official duties, excluding other material in these archive packets.
policy.short: Separately inspect authentic short body excerpts. Treat absent paragraph-only results as unassessed. No short mixed-authorship prevalence or extrapolation.
